canonicalPrepareFailures.interpretation: Loaded owned preview processes held the generated client DLL; neither application result nor qualification
Branch-owned MySQL DDL was misplaced in the SQLite migration path; corrected in c361 with separate SQLite and unchanged MySQL copies
Generated absolute links resolve into owned dependencies, but the unchanged canonical guard requires relative literals. No engine or link repair or sealing bypass.

actualWebcam.uncertainty: Observed recent update rate included 1.1Hz. Foreground, video viewport, OS occlusion, real motion, gaming and concurrent build were not controlled; no causal attribution or throughput acceptance.

syntheticPresentationNegativeControl.interpretation: Scrolling alone did not reproduce the 1Hz observation. Offscreen presentation dropped counters coexisted with about30Hz fresh callbacks and advancing total frames. Actual camera, headed/OS occlusion, application pump and neural inference were not measured; no causal patch justified.

syntheticIdenticalContentNegativeControl.interpretation: Identical redraws and one changed source pixel both produced about30Hz callbacks in this headless synthetic stream. Neither content identity nor scrolling alone reproduced the prior1Hz actual-webcam observation. The actual camera, ordinary headed/OS occlusion and Reach pump remain unmeasured causes; no source patch is inferred.

caveats: All browser proof is bounded development evidence from an isolated synthetic fixture or public photograph; no private owner footage is published.
No native IR/depth transport, registered multi-camera fusion or proven illumination control is supplied.
Independent held-out raw3% requirements, current150ms freshness and source/context invalidation remain unchanged.
Unit counts overlap. Browser and hardware contexts differ and are not pooled as fleet reliability or physical latency.
